question: Where was International Abhidhamma Day celebrated in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Greater Noida.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **International Abhidhamma Day was celebrated on the full moon day of Śharada Pūrṇimā (6-7 October 2025) at Gautam Buddha University, Greater Noida.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The International Buddhist Confederation (IBC) and several partners organized the event to celebrate the significance of Abhidhamma in Buddhist thought.**
 
• **An international conference was held on the theme “The Relevance of Abhidhamma in Understanding Buddhist Thought,” which included discussions on philosophy, ethics, and psychology.**
 
• **The conference featured over 35 papers presented by scholars from India, Myanmar, Cambodia, Vietnam, and Sri Lanka.**
 
• **The event also explored the intersection between Abhidhamma and modern sciences like psychology, artificial intelligence, and cognitive studies.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Abhidhamma__

 __
 
• A key teaching in Buddhism that deals with the philosophical, ethical, and psychological aspects of the Buddha's teachings.
 
 
 
• Tavatimsa Heaven__
 __
 
• A celestial realm in Buddhist cosmology where the Buddha is said to have preached the Abhidhamma to gods, led by his mother Mahamaya.
 
 
 
• Gautam Buddha University__
 
 
• Located in Greater Noida, it is a leading center for higher education and research in Buddhist studies.
